verdict.rationale: Deel's own docs describe a first-party webhook system that delivers real-time notifications for platform events and signs them with HMAC-SHA256, so this is direct support for programmatic event consumption. The evidence does not list any event types, so the specific payroll lifecycle events in the story are unconfirmed, and it does not show how a developer registers or subscribes. missing for 10: documented event catalog covering payroll processed, employee onboarded and payment failed, subscription/registration mechanics (endpoint setup, event filtering), retry/delivery guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe to payroll lifecycle events (payroll processed, employee onboarded, payment failed) via webhooks to drive downstream automations

citations.quote: Deel Webhooks deliver real-time notifications for key platform events, allowing you to build efficient and responsive integrations without relying on constant polling.
Webhooks are secured using HMAC-SHA256 signatures
